title: THE ARENA fight on the lab's engine: the lab's MK-9 and an endless station, the lure held in the disc and off the MK-9's ring, Isao drives under the seat, her body owns her position with the lab's fear per gun and temperament, she stalks the hull at the lure's tangent band
context: Owner, 2026-10-23: 'the Nih-Dairia fight; there is a well-tuned version in the lab and we keep reproducing something that does not work. a) not enough nukes on the gunship, b) nih-dairia aggro is different, c) the whole idea is the monster aggro on the tank, acting as a lure, and it leaves time for the player to use the gunship to hit it, d) it should stay in the arena, e) the gameplay is that it tries to aggro on the tank, but fears the 40mm, so the gunship fires 40mm between the boss and the auto-moving tank, leaving room for a clean nuke.' Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-23-arena-lab-fight-design.md (the diagnosis verified before the night): in the game the record owned her position (a cell-graph walker the kit's body trailed on a leash), one MK-9 a pass with a 20 s reload and a 120 s station, no arena term in the lure once a quarry existed, and the fright written into the walker's scare fields; none of the lab's fight (its own pursuit, the fear per gun, the temperament, the 120 m bound, the 6 s seat reload) ran in the game.
outcome: Branch arena-lab-fight from day-42 (c96d6ded), seven commits, unpushed. (a) The gunship rig reads its guns and its orbit through the host each call; boss-run hands the content's guns with the MK-9 at perPass 0 and BOSS_FIGHT.arenaGuns.reload 6 s through the boss phase and `over`, and an endless station (station Infinity) while she lives; the seat's Station field and the strip read ON STATION. The orbit getter reads the arena's before the tune panel's: applyTune always writes tune.orbit, so the spec's order (panel first) never applied (the first run lost the station at 105 s). (d) src/domain/lure.js insideArena/keepInside and lureMode inArena: in the boss phase the hull keeps within BOSS_FIGHT.bounds.radius - baitMargin (11 cells) of the arena's cell and drives back in from outside. (b, c, e) The lab's fear and temperament moved to src/fx/boss/ (the lab imports them from there); new src/fx/boss/arena-fight.js runs them for her in the arena's own plane, and boss-run marks her record bodyLed once her body is made: src/fx/creature-reed.js's led track hunts the point handed in and is never leashed or re-placed, src/fx/enemy-step.js's ledPoint gives the record her body's point and the cell under it (no walk, no scare turn, no emergence offset, no shove; touch, damage and death kept); every shell reaches the fight (the 25 mm's barrage, the 40 mm's wild flight, the MK-9's panic, each within its blast + fear.reach of a contact or a node). Decisions the spec did not settle: the MK-9 keeps note 8c's 1.5 s stun before the lab's panic (the lab's bait mode panics with no stun; the spec's test wants a stun); her body hunts the point BOSS_FIGHT.arenaBoss.keep 45 m from the hull on the line toward her, from either side (measured in node on the real kit: aiming at the hull itself her own pursuit holds it ~20 m centre to centre whatever the chase-speed knob or a 15 m/s hull, a catch; keep 30 left her under the lure's near band so Isao ran to the rim and she cornered the hull there; 45 puts her ~57 m off, in the tangent band); the frame advances the hull under the gunship's seat while Isao has it on the lure (boss-run drives(); before, td-tab stopped the hull under any manned seat, so the lure never moved during the fight); the lure keeps off the MK-9's own ring by LURE.nuke 7 cells and a hull inside it drives straight out (LURE.blast 4 let an MK-9 painted on her take the hull whole). Measured by --arena-fight (150 s of game clock, 0.99x in headless, the hull put down 6 open cells from the arena's centre, a 40 mm 25 m from her toward the hull every 8 s, an MK-9 only with the hull its blast + 2 cells clear): (a) the MK-9 ready again 10.28 s after a launch, a second release the same pass; (b) the hull at most 10.94 cells from the arena's centre, she at most 10.43 (disc 12), the gap 2.0 to 13.5 cells, no hull lost; (c) 19 wild scares from 19 shells, the first opening the gap 5.96 -> 13.16 cells within 3 s; (d) 2 stuns, 2 panics; (e) on station all 150 s. Her ground speed hunting 9.8 m/s (fleeing 26.8, stunned 5.4, peak 57.5) against the hull's lure 9.6 m/s.
alternatives: Keeping the record as the owner of her position and tuning the walker's pace and scare (the 2026-10-18 note 8c path): that is the path the owner says keeps not working; the lab's fight is a body behaviour.
Slowing her chase speed instead of the keep: the kit's ground speed barely follows the knob (node: x0.35 still ~22 m off a 9.4 m/s hull), it is the pursuit's reach and pull that move her.
A faster hull on the lure (15 m/s in node): she still held it at ~25 m on a circle; the keep mirrors the lab's own bait geometry (its Isao keeps 20 m outside her reach).
Reading the tune panel's orbit first as the spec wrote: applyTune always sets it, so the arena's station would never apply.
